chunks: Glorified is He who assigned feet to the minute ant and the gnat, and to those above them in creation, the whales and the elephants! He made it obligatory upon Himself that no skeleton in which He infused the spirit would move, except that He made death its appointed time and destruction its final end.

key_terms.الْحِمَامَ: death / the appointed time of death

ai.seo_question: What does Nahj al-Balagha say about God's creation of small and large animals?
ai.summary: Imam Ali highlights the divine precision in creating microorganisms like ants and larger beasts like whales, attributing their structural integrity to God's self-imposed decree that every animated being must eventually perish. This passage underscores the transient nature of creation, contrasting the intricate design of life with its inevitable return to dust, a theme central to Shia meditations on mortality and divine unity.

en.sayed-ali-raza: [The magnificence of the Creator in great and small creation :]

Glorified is Allāh who has assigned feet to small ants and gnats and also to those above them, the serpents and the elephants. He has made it obligatory upon Himself that no skeleton in which He infuses the spirit would move, but that death is its promised place and destruction its final end.
